row.title: A PR bound and a model-free merge for additive conflicts
row.body: PRs sat open for hours because lane.sh only labelled conflicted and failed session PRs and waited on a dead executor, and both-sides-additive registry rows counted as conflicts. ADDITIVE-MERGE-1 resolves those without a model; PR-BOUND-1 closes past 30/60 min with the branch kept; detector pr-age-bound fails on any PR open past 2 h.

title: A PR bound and a model-free merge for additive conflicts
